name: Buy proxy / create order (deterministic)
trigger: \b(i want to|i need to|help me|get me|set me up|buy|order|purchase)\s+(a|an|the|my)?\s*(proxy|proxies|subscription|plan)\b

actions.text: Here are the available plans above. Which one would you like? Tell me the plan type (residential, mobile, isp, or datacenter) and country, and I'll set it up for you.

notes: Shows product catalog and asks customer to choose. Actual order creation (create_order) is a write operation requiring explicit confirmation.
